annotations.title: How the ASPERN rating is made

description: How the ASPERN rating is made, and how the rated vaults are spread across its letters. The scale (A+ … D, the letter family tied to the report’s levels: low A, moderate B, high C, severe D), the eight components with their weights, inputs, thresholds and what leaves each not rated, the share ladder for collateral, borrowers and oracles, the overall rule, the caps, the band ceiling, what it cannot see, version and changelog. `distribution` counts vaults by overall letter, by component letter and by cap over the documents of the last two days; nothing is named. Free.
name: rating_methodology

distribution.description: vaults, rated, notRated, byRating, byComponent, caps, byCoverage, at, says. Null where it could not be counted just now.
